# RFC 3161 interoperability fixtures

These test-only files are generated by OpenSSL and exercise the fixed
Forecast Ledger profile: SHA-256, a positive nonce, embedded signer
certificate, critical timestamping EKU, and a retained PEM root.

Regenerate from this directory with `sh generate.sh`. The certificates and
signatures intentionally change on regeneration; tests assert independently
verifiable semantics rather than fixed signature bytes. Private keys and the
temporary CA database are generated in a confined temporary directory and are
not retained.

The checked-in target is the exact canonical target for
`q-election-coalition` / `f-election-coalition-001` in the pinned v2.0.1
individual-ledger fixture (SHA-256
`e232db4b3ef9609976f34a6abc70a56faf39e6811f6f5d2a17655afc039aa391`).
The checked-in request and response were generated with OpenSSL 3.6.0. The Go
tests parse and verify them locally. The generation script also runs
`openssl ts -verify` before copying any public fixture into this directory.

The `freetsa/` directory contains a separate byte-exact public-provider
fixture captured once from the qualified HTTPS endpoint. Its README records
provenance, commands, profiles, and digests. Normal tests never refresh it.
